name: Treder Shop Buddy
author: Ben Treder

sections.description:
Treder Shop Buddy is a friendly WooCommerce companion plugin that helps store owners improve their shop without digging through confusing settings.

It gives you a simple store helper inside WordPress with product checks, setup guidance, quick product tools, trust messages, and easy shortcodes.

It is built for small WooCommerce shops that want cleaner products, better trust signals, and an easier way to stay organized.

What it helps with

  • See helpful store setup reminders
  • Check product health
  • Find products that need photos, categories, prices, or better descriptions
  • Quickly create simple products
  • Add a trust bar to pages
  • Add a simple product grid with a shortcode
  • Keep WooCommerce easier to understand for everyday store owners

Free features

  • Store dashboard
  • Setup Checklist
  • Product Health checks
  • Quick Product helper
  • Trust bar shortcode
  • Product grid shortcode
  • Simple settings page
  • WooCommerce-focused helper tools

Shortcodes

Display a simple WooCommerce product grid:

[treder_shop_buddy_grid limit="6" columns="3"]

Display a simple trust bar:

[treder_shop_buddy_trust_bar]

Premium companion

Treder Shop Buddy Premium is available separately from BenTreder.com.

Premium adds a Growth Center, Product Optimizer, Promo Builder, Trust Builder, Sales Booster, Advanced Reports, AI Setup Guide, AI Diagnostics, and AI Copy Studio for premium formatted product description drafts.

The free version works on its own and is the base engine for the Premium companion.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Upload the Treder Shop Buddy plugin ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it from WordPress.org once approved.
  3. Activate Treder Shop Buddy.
  4. Go to Shop Buddy in your WordPress admin menu.
  5. Review the setup checklist and product health tools.
  6. Add the trust bar or product grid shortcodes to pages if needed.
sections.faq:
Does this replace WooCommerce?

No. Treder Shop Buddy is a WooCommerce companion. WooCommerce still handles products, cart, checkout, orders, and payments.

Do I need WooCommerce?

Yes. Treder Shop Buddy is made for WooCommerce stores.

Does the free version work by itself?

Yes. The free version includes the setup checklist, product health checks, quick product helper, trust bar shortcode, and product grid shortcode.

What does Premium add?

Premium adds more advanced store growth tools, including AI Copy Studio, Promo Builder, Trust Builder, Sales Booster sections, Product Optimizer, and Advanced Reports.

Does the plugin send my store data somewhere?

The free plugin does not send store data to an external service.

Can I use the shortcodes with Elementor or the block editor?

Yes. You can place the shortcodes in a Shortcode block, Elementor shortcode widget, or most page builder shortcode areas.
